display.purpose: Hero and section headlines. Archivo at width 112. Never above 3.9rem.

figure.purpose: Prices, payments and any number the reader compares. Always tabular lining.

body.purpose: Manrope. All running copy, controls and table text.

label.purpose: Uppercase field and category labels. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: sh-2
shadows.purpose: Search plate, financing plate, callout figures.

shadows.name: sh-3
shadows.purpose: Hero plate, hovered vehicle cards, modals.

shadows.name: sh-blue
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons and range thumbs only, so the live layer reads as lit.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out; the default for every state change.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric moves that return to where they started.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: Image scale on hover, meter fills.

motion.name: plate-draw
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the hero vehicle outline draws itself once via stroke-dashoffset, then its callouts fade in at 1.15s / 1.3s / 1.45s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Every primary action. The only filled blue surface on a page.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:#1a4cff; color:#fff; font:700 14.5px/1 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.005em; box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(11,47,181,.18), 0 12px 26px -14px rgba(11,47,181,.45); transition:background 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#0b2fb5; box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(11,47,181,.22), 0 18px 36px -16px rgba(11,47,181,.55); } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1a4cff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary one, and standalone controls on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid #c2bbaa; border-radius:4px; background:#fffefb; color:#0f1b33; font:700 14.5px/1 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,51,.05); transition:border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:#2c3a55; background:#f6f4ef; }

components.name: Field
components.description: The standard form field: an uppercase label over a 44px control that tints blue on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5d6b85; } .ds-field input { height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #c2bbaa; border-radius:4px; background:#fffefb; color:#0f1b33; font-size:15px; transition:border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#5d6b85; } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#1a4cff; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #e9edff; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Body-style and smart filters. Selected body chips go ink; selected smart filters go live blue.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; height:38px; padding:0 14px; margin-right:8px; border:1px solid #d9d4c7; border-radius:4px; background:#fffefb; color:#2c3a55; font:600 13.5px/1 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#c2bbaa; color:#0f1b33; } .ds-chip.is-on { background:#1a4cff; border-color:#1a4cff; color:#fff; }

components.name: Trust Badge
components.description: The four-at-most signals on a vehicle card. Green states a fact verified, gold a caution, red a problem.
components.html: Clean titleSalt belt 2y
components.css: .ds-tb { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; margin-right:6px; padding:4px 8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:2px; font:700 11.5px/1.3 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-tb.ok { background:#e1f2e9; color:#075c3a; border-color:#b9dfcb; } .ds-tb.warn { background:#fbf0dd; color:#8a5200; border-color:#e2c68a; } .ds-tb.bad { background:#fbeae9; color:#b3261e; border-color:#edbdb9; }

components.css: .ds-card { background:#fffefb; border:1px solid #d9d4c7; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; transition:border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#c2bbaa; box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(15,27,51,.06), 0 22px 48px -22px rgba(15,27,51,.30); transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-card-body { padding:16px; display:grid; gap:10px; } .ds-price { font:700 25px/1 Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif; font-stretch:112%; letter-spacing:-.028em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#0f1b33; } .ds-price span { font:700 11px/1 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5d6b85; } .ds-mo { font:400 13px/1.4 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#2c3a55; } .ds-mo b { color:#1a4cff; } .ds-mo i { font-style:normal; color:#5d6b85; } .ds-title { font:700 17px/1.22 Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif; font-stretch:112%; letter-spacing:-.018em; color:#0f1b33; } .ds-trim { font:500 13px/1.4 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#5d6b85; }

components.description: Sticky header nav. The active item is underlined by a blue rule that scales in from the left.
components.html: BrowseClosed pricesWanted
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:2px; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position:relative; padding:9px 13px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:600; color:#2c3a55; text-decoration:none; border-radius:4px; transition:color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:13px; right:13px; bottom:4px; height:2px; background:#1a4cff; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#0f1b33; background:#efebe1; } .ds-nav a.is-on { color:#0f1b33; } .ds-nav a.is-on::after { transform:scaleX(1); }

components.name: Callout
components.description: A leader line from a drawing to the figure it measures. Only ever carries a computed number.
components.css: .ds-callout { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-callout .lead { position:relative; flex:none; width:54px; height:1px; background:#0f1b33; } .ds-callout .lead::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; width:5px; height:5px; margin-top:-2.5px; border-radius:50%; background:#0f1b33; } .ds-callout .fig { display:grid; gap:1px; padding:7px 11px; background:#fffefb; border:1px solid #c2bbaa; border-radius:2px; box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(15,27,51,.05), 0 10px 22px -14px rgba(15,27,51,.22); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-callout .fig i { font-style:normal; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5d6b85; } .ds-callout .fig b { font:700 15px/1.2 Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif; font-stretch:112%; letter-spacing:-.01em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#1a4cff; }

narrative.overview:
Driveway's job is to make a private car sale arguable with numbers instead of adjectives, so the interface is built like a page from a factory service manual: warm paper stock, deep navy plate ink for all type and line-work, and vehicles drawn as side elevations in one outline weight rather than photographed. Leader lines run from a drawing to the figure it carries, and numbers are tabular so one column reads against another.

The one thing a printed manual never had is a live layer, and that is where electric blue lives. Blue means the marketplace computed this, or you can act on this — primary buttons, active states, estimated payments, comp-anchored values, focus rings — and it appears nowhere else. Green is rationed to deal ratings, verification and success; gold to star ratings. A green pill means the same thing on every surface.

The anti-references are the two rooms this category always ships: the dusk photograph behind a dark gradient with a red accent and a floating search bar, and the classifieds grid of unlabeled thumbnails. Neither is here. A listing with no photographs draws its own elevation, and says in words that it is a drawing.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, deep navy ink, one saturated blue that only ever means live
Everything drawn: 1.6-unit outline icons and 4-unit vehicle elevations, one stroke family
Hairline rules and 2–4px radii; the page is cut, not rounded
Tabular lining numerals wherever two figures could be compared
One authored motion moment and nothing else that loops on its own

rules.name: The Live Layer Rule
rules.body: Electric blue marks what the marketplace computed or what the visitor can act on. Never decoration, never a car's paint, never a section background.

rules.name: One Job Per Signal Colour
rules.body: Green is deal ratings, verification and success. Gold is star ratings and the caution register. Red is destructive and error. None of the three ever borrows another's job.

rules.name: No Kickers
rules.body: An uppercase label names a field or a category. It never sits above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: Every Comparable Number Is Tabular
rules.body: Prices, mileage, payments, ratings and table cells all carry font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums, so a column of figures lines up.

rules.name: Depth Is Structural
rules.body: A shadow says a plate sits above the paper. Every shadow carries an offset and a soft blur and is tinted with the navy ink. Most surfaces separate with a hairline instead.

rules.name: Icons Are Drawn
rules.body: Every interface glyph comes from public/js/icons.js: a 24 grid, 1.6 stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor. No emoji, no Unicode dingbats.

dos: Do reach for blue when something is actionable or computed, and for nothing else.
Do draw any new icon on the 24 grid at 1.6 stroke and add it to public/js/icons.js.
Do give any figure a reader might compare tabular lining numerals.
Do label an estimate as an estimate, in the place it is shown.
Do let a listing with no photographs draw itself, and say in words that it is a drawing.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces — selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring, underline offset — from these tokens.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use an emoji or a Unicode dingbat as an interface icon.
Don't paint a car in Live Blue, or use green for anything but a deal rating, verification or success.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or use a grid of same-size icon-heading-text cards as a page's structure.
Don't add a second looping animation; the hero plate drawing itself is the one authored moment.
Don't state a rate, a credit decision or a customer testimonial: there is no lender and there are no testimonials.
